# Sky Inspect

## Summary
Sky Inspect provides AI-assisted autonomous drone roof inspections for roofers, insurers, property teams, and facility operators across New England.

## What Sky Inspect Does
- Flies repeatable autonomous roof survey grids.
- Captures geotagged roof imagery.
- Returns AI-assisted OK, Review, and Urgent triage labels for qualified human review.
- Offers pilot inspections and refundable preorder reservations.

## Important Limits
- Sky Inspect does not replace engineering judgment, insurance coverage decisions, code review, or required hands-on inspections.
- Triage labels are not warranties or final diagnoses.
- Flight availability depends on weather, airspace authorization, property access, local restrictions, and safe operating conditions.
